summary: Recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology. Built transformer models from scratch in PyTorch, including a GPT-2 style language model and a Whisper-style ASR decoder, and fine-tuned a document understanding transformer from 55% to 93% validation accuracy. Applied 8-bit quantization to a 1.1B-parameter LLM with under 1% accuracy degradation across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC, and cut inference latency 5.2x with TensorRT.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT, an OCR-free document understanding transformer, on a custom medical billing dataset for structured field extraction; improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93%.
Built PyTorch training pipelines with the Hugging Face VisionEncoderDecoder API and domain-specific tokens.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Trained U-Net segmentation with VGG-16/19 and ResNet-50 backbones; offline evaluation on Dice Score and IoU.
Led a team of 7 as the sole ML-experienced student, delivering the full pipeline within a 6-week window.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 images to 83% mAP@50; exported to ONNX and TFLite for mobile deployment.

projects.name: GPT-2 Style Language Model from Scratch
bullets: Implemented a GPT-2 style Transformer from scratch in PyTorch: multi-head self-attention, MLP blocks, residual connections, layer normalization, and weight tying.
Built a TikToken tokenizer wrapper and a custom training loop with perplexity evaluation.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B; profiled peak VRAM and inference latency using pynvml.
Benchmarked on HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC: <1% accuracy loss, +0.09 perplexity.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) - MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a three-layer distributed AI pipeline (Flutter, Flask-SocketIO, Jetson) integrating faster-whisper STT, Gemini LLM intent classification, and TensorRT-optimized YOLO.
Cut inference latency 5.2x (56.7 to 10.9 ms) with TensorRT; achieved 100% task reliability over 10 trials at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.
Diagnosed and resolved 11 system failure modes, including false positives and stale-frame capture.

projects.name: Whisper-Style ASR from Scratch
bullets: Built an end-to-end ASR pipeline with an 80-channel mel spectrogram encoder and a 4-block causal Transformer decoder with cross-attention; achieved 15% WER on a Hindi-English dataset.
Designed a custom BPE tokenizer with a Cython backend, 4-5.5x faster than pure Python.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Replaced TorchScript conv layers with custom CUDA C++ kernels, achieving 1.5-2x convolution speedup.
